title: Styles of negotiator and types of person
header_line: My analysis of one book on negotiation. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Which style are you when you negotiate, and which is your counterpart?

I said that analysts can be more introverted than extroverted, but not necessarily; the S is the list maker, the T is the high thinker. Then I turned to the accommodator and said you can see how the personality test breaks down further.
I described one type as creative, enthusiastic and people-focused, who love to inspire and motivate others, and are always championing things.
I said that the purpose of the test is to do it in five minutes, that is how fast you should do it, and I have given the group the test in meetings.
I said to read biographies of people who have the same personality as you.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write the style you think you use.
Write the style you think they use.
Write what that means for the first five minutes.
Write one biography of someone like you.
Write what you will not assume from a letter.

check.q: What did I say the test's purpose is?
What did I say to read?
choices: Biographies of people with your personality

check.q: What kind of description is the type list?

recap: Know the styles. Place people quickly. Do not treat a type as a verdict.
